planned_strategic_entries.thesis: Four unrelated remediations completed this week and left the attacker holding something the fix does not reach: warehouse credentials Metabase already handed over, a Windchill keystore Cl0p decrypted in one command, build hosts that ran a crates.io payload before the crate was yanked, and TrueConf clients trojanised and distributed by the server two months after the server was patched. The distinguishing property vs 2026-08-09/weekly-w32-the-vendor-fix-was-not-the-end-state (where the fix itself was incomplete or bypassable) is that here the fix is complete and correct — the compromise has simply moved into a substrate the version number does not describe.

Three unrelated disclosures 17-23 Aug remove the endpoint agent by three different mechanisms sitting at three different layers, and the vulnerable-driver blocklist answers exactly one of them. Akira reboots into Safe Mode with Networking so no third-party service starts (a boot-configuration change, nothing to blocklist); SPECTRE loads one of two long-known vulnerable drivers and unlinks process, thread and image-load callbacks (blocklistable — the question is enforcement); BTR.sys is Defender's own required signed driver extracted from the local MpEngine.dll, which Check Point states cannot be blocklisted without breaking Defender. Distinct from 2026-08-16/weekly-w33-kernel-rootkits-edit-what-windows-reports, whose subject was rootkits falsifying the report — here the subject is the agent's ability to run and to be told at all, and the control that answers each case is different.

Four CVEs this week where the authorities disagree about whether the flaw is exploited, and the disagreement runs in both directions: CISA KEV says exploited and Microsoft's record still says no (IKEEXT CVE-2026-33824, four months unrevised; SharePoint CVE-2026-55040, unrevised since 14 July); Microsoft corrected Entra CVE-2026-69836 to not-exploited and ENISA's EUVD, re-synced a day later, still carries it on the exploited feed; and Zimbra CVE-2026-73570 was patched in July with no identifier at all, so no feed could carry a flag until 13 August. Neither 'trust the vendor' nor 'trust the catalogue' is a safe default. Distinct from 2026-08-09/weekly-w32-cve-record-unreliable-in-both-directions, which was about the identifier itself (fabricated CVEs, missing CVEs, one CVE per bug class); this is about the exploitation flag on identifiers that exist and are correct.

Five European public bodies disclosed this week and in every one the disclosing organisation could not answer a basic question about its own incident — and in three of the five it was the attacker, not a control, that set the disclosure timetable. AK Oberösterreich cannot scope because the traces were wiped, so every member gets an Article 34 letter. Latvia's CSDD was found by its own staff in hours while the provider contracted for round-the-clock monitoring neither detected nor alerted, and the asset boundary of 'monitored' had never been established. Martigny-Combe had eight days of quiet mailbox access ended by the attacker mailing 450 of the commune's own contacts. HWZ learned its students' bank details were gone through a provider it does not name and a leak-site listing it did not publish. Castilla-La Mancha confirms the attack and nothing about the data. Distinct from 2026-08-16/weekly-w33-compromised-party-was-not-the-notifying-party (a third party on the access path displacing the notification duty) — here the notification exists and the facts behind it do not.

Three independent in-window disclosures put AI inside the adversary's own operation rather than in a research demo, and in none of them does it produce a new technique. UAT-10147 ran mass exploitation of five years-old CVEs behind an AI-generated ViewState playbook and four automation scripts, with DeepAudit and PentestGPT on its own management server; five US agencies report AI-developed python-snap7 tooling against S7 PLCs disguised as OT monitoring software, against exposed controllers and weak authentication; and PurpleDelta's operators applied to 1,100+ companies at up to 60 positions a day behind AI-generated photos and real-time chatbot interview assistants. What AI bought in all three is throughput and coverage against unchanged tradecraft. Portable defender heuristic from Talos: a completeness reflex — three redundant implementations labelled as alternatives where a human targeting one kernel would pick one — as a code-provenance tell.

Three in-window disclosures put the C2 rendezvous on infrastructure a defender cannot reputation-block: Red Canary records three of four new top-ten entrants resolving C2 from a dead drop, two off a public blockchain contract; PATCHCORD's cluster runs tasking through the Google Sheets API v4 and GitHub Gists; StopAndProtect hosts payloads, C2 and stolen data on ~2,000 hijacked WordPress sites. Complement to 2026-08-09/weekly-w32-half-of-c2-never-asks-dns — that measured C2 that skips name resolution; this is C2 whose name resolves correctly to a service the estate has a legitimate reason to reach. The control in every case is an egress baseline keyed on process-and-role, not a blocklist. CANDIDATE — verify it clears W-PD-1 against the W32 entry before publishing.

Two court filings this week name Switzerland — the Zurich District Court indictment over LockerGoga/MegaCortex/Nefilim (four named Swiss victims, CHF 100m+) and DOJ's superseding indictment against Iran's Mabna Institute (Swiss universities and Swiss companies in both foreign-victim lists). Both describe operations that closed six and nine years ago, and both describe tradecraft that is exactly current. The strategic value of a charge sheet is evidentiary corroboration of technique ordering, on a judicial timescale that defence cannot wait for. CANDIDATE — thin; publish only if it clears W-PD-1 on its own merits.
Fresh delta: the implant is reverse-engineered (ReliaQuest 2026-08-18) and General Electric joined Philips and Shell in responding. Pending W1's status re-check.
